You are a Python 3.12 engineer adding a story-agnostic projection to freytag-forge, approved by Brandon (plan: .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback-plan.md, Step 2 bullet 'Compare the historical opening sources with the actual opening payload'; read it, and read docs/world-model-grounding.md plus docs/world-model-grounding/prompt-inputs.md and docs/narrator-writing-guide.md first). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (branch 1a-opening-and-truck-feedback). No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit.

YOU MAY EDIT: packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py (one new World method), a NEW test file packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_area_contents.py, storygame/runtime/item_facts.py, a NEW tests/test_opening_scene_things.py, and existing tests under tests/ ONLY where a pin truly changes because of this fix (list each in your report). Never edit data/, docs/, bench/, .plans/, scripts/. Shared runtime has NO story names (no Kristin, Michelle, kitchen, workstation, chair, back door, drawer, truck, laptop): build everything from world data and generic words. No keyword tables.

THE DEFECT (verified in a stubbed product-wired capture): the 1A opening narrator prompt has `THINGS:\n- Kristin. Place: Michelle's kitchen.` and nothing else. The workstation's authored placement text `across the kitchen from the back door` (data/stories/continuity-initiative/plot.md) and the back door never reach the opening, so the narrator cannot show the room's layout. Cause: `ItemFactsProvider._thing_names` (item_facts.py) returns, when `self._example_player_input` is empty (the opening), only `dependency_names()` plus the protagonist; the place-scoped feed for turns never runs at the opening.

CHANGE A (packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py): add `World.visible_area_contents(self, area_id)` returning the sorted ids of the DIRECT contents of that area that are currently visible (use self.contents and self.is_visible) and are not themselves areas. It reads only world state. Do NOT include contents of containers or supporters, and never include anything hidden, missing or shut away. Tests in packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_area_contents.py (follow the helpers in test_world.py): visible direct children listed; a hidden child, a missing child, a child of a closed container, a child on a supporter, and a sub-area are NOT listed; empty area returns ().

CHANGE B (item_facts.py, `_thing_names`): ONLY for the opening (`_example_player_input` empty) and ONLY when the protagonist has a known area (`world.area(protagonist_id)` is not None), after the existing expansion loop and before returning, append the names of `world.visible_area_contents(protagonist_area)` that are in `self.item_facts`, are not already listed and are not the protagonist, using the same `self._entity_label(world, id)` naming the loop uses. Do not call given_with on them and do not add their contents, so the opening shows the room's visible things with the authored placement text the existing THINGS line already renders (`- <name>. Place: <authored text or parent name>.`), and shows nothing that is hidden or inside a container. Keep turn paths (non-empty `_example_player_input`) byte-identical. If the opening THINGS block is also built somewhere else for the retry or verifier path, make sure it uses the same names; report where.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_opening_scene_things.py (hermetic; follow tests/test_place_scoped_feed.py and tests/test_boarding_turn_prompt.py for building the provider and capturing the opening user prompt with the network stubbed): (a) the continuity-initiative opening THINGS now lists the workstation with the line `Place: across the kitchen from the back door.` and the back door, still lists Kristin first or as before, and does NOT list the hidden memory card, Michelle's phone or anything inside the drawer; (b) a turn prompt for a command like 'Open the drawer.' is byte-identical to before this change (compare against a pre-change capture you take BEFORE editing, stored only in /tmp); (c) a synthetic second package (use the helpers in tests/test_place_scoped_feed.py `_synthetic_package`) gets its own start-area things in the opening with its own names; (d) a protagonist with no known area adds nothing; (e) a closed container in the start area lists the container but not what is shut inside it.

PAYLOAD DIFF (report it): run `.venv/bin/python .plans/world-model-s1/prompt_capture.py /tmp/payload-after.json` before and after your edit (save the before copy outside the repo) and list every key that differs. Only opening payloads may differ; justify each. Update pins in existing tests only with the minimal change, and list them.

DONE WHEN the check passes. Report: files changed, existing tests updated and why, the payload diff, and anything you could not do.
